title: Klaviyo Account Manager, Retention Marketing (Remote)
description: About the role We're hiring a Klaviyo Account Manager to lead retention for a portfolio of 6 to 7 high growth DTC ecommerce brands. This isn't a\ "send the emails\" role. We position ourselves as retention partners, not vendors. That means going deep into each client's business, understanding their margins, customer lifecycle, brand voice, and product roadmap, then building a Klaviyo strategy that actually moves the P&L.You'll own strategy, copy direction, the client relationship, and a small pod of two people (a designer and a Klaviyo implementation specialist who builds your designs out inside the platform). You'll write the copy yourself, leveraging AI and our internal prompt libraries to move faster and better. You'll have meaningful room to grow with the agency.A bit about us We're a small, scrappy retention agency working with 7, 8, and 9 figure DTC brands. We're early in our build out, which means a few things: there's no bureaucracy, decisions move fast, the work you do shapes how the agency operates, and strong people get more responsibility quickly. We're growing, and we want the people we hire now to grow with us as we scale.If you're the kind of person who looks at a small team and thinks\ "I can help build this,\" instead of\ "where's the org chart,\" you'll like it here.What you'll own Strategy. You set the retention strategy for each of your clients. Flow architecture, campaign calendars, segmentation, deliverability, A/B testing roadmap, all of it. You think like an operator, not just an email marketer.Copy.You write the copy yourself, using our internal AI prompt libraries (Claude and ChatGPT) as leverage. You don't need to be a prompt engineer. Basic comfort with LLMs is enough, and we'll teach you the rest.Client relationships.You're the face of the engagement. Some clients want weekly calls. Others prefer a clean weekly report and async Slack. You read the room and tailor it.Team.You lead a small pod of two: a designer who creates the email visuals, and a technician who builds your designs into Klaviyo. You set the brief, review the work, and make sure everything ships on time at the quality bar your clients deserve.Deliverables.The biggest measure of success here is simple: did the work get shipped, was it good, and is the client happy? We're not chasing vanity metrics. We're chasing a fulfilling, high quality service.Who you are You've worked inside Klaviyo before. You don't need 5 years of platform experience, but you understand the principles. Flows vs campaigns, segmentation, deliverability, list health, A/B testing. If we asked you to architect a welcome series or a winback flow, you'd know where to start.You understand DTC ecommerce. Margins, AOV, LTV, product launches, post purchase journeys, the whole game. You can hold a real conversation with a 7 figure founder about their business.You're a leader. You're going to be the most senior person on your pod. You give clear direction, take ownership when things go wrong, make your team better, and don't pass the buck. Equally important: you can listen, take feedback, and update your views when someone makes a better point. Strong opinions, loosely held.You're strategic and intelligent. The work doesn't have to be perfect. Nothing ever is. But your thinking has to be sharp. Things change fast in DTC and inside our agency, and you have to adapt without melting down.You're fluent in English. You'll be running calls with native English speaking founders.You're AI curious. You don't need to be running custom GPTs on day one. But if your gut reaction to AI is\ "this is going to take my job\" or\ "I prefer doing it the old way,\ " this role isn't for you. Weuse AI everywhere we can, and we'll teach you our stack.What's in it for youReal ownership.You run your pod like a mini agency inside the agency. You set the strategy, you direct the team, you own the client relationship. We don't micromanage.Rapid growth.We're early stage. The people who help us build now will lead pods, then departments, as we scale. No waiting in line for a promotion. Do good work, get more responsibility, fast.A masterclass in DTC retention.You'll work on 7, 8, and 9 figure brands, see what's actually working at scale, and build expertise that's worth real money in this market.AI training.We'll teach you how to use Claude, ChatGPT, and our internal prompt libraries to make your copy and strategy work faster and better. By the end of year one, you'll be using AI in ways most marketers haven't figured out yet.Flexible hours.We don't track time. As long as the work ships, clients are happy, and you're available when the team needs you, work whenever you do your best work.A friendly team.We're not a punish heavy,\ "perform or get fired\" shop.We're a small group that cares about the work and about each other. You'll have direct access to the founders.Performance bonuses in time.As we grow, top performers will share in the upside.Don't apply if You wait to be told what to do. You're scared of AI or refuse to use it. You're shopping for a 6 month gig before your next move. You can't take feedback or admit when you're wrong.Apply if You want to own a portfolio, build a pod, learn DTC at depth, and grow fast inside a small team that's going somewhere.

title: FM Supervisor
description:
About DPDHL and CRE:

Deutsche Post DHL (DPDHL) the logistics provider of the world with over 600,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. We are an organization that is not just moving goods around, we have a very clear purpose, and we are: Connecting People. Improving Lives. We provide challenges and opportunities for personal and professional development, we recognize the difference you bring to our business and together we share the pride of building one of the largest world leaders in logistics and supply chain.


Corporate Real Estate (CRE) at Deutsche Post DHL (DPDHL) is responsible for more than 12,000 properties across all DPDHL business units worldwide. This portfolio covers an area of more than 30 million m2 and is managed by around 1700 dedicated real estate experts worldwide. As our business keeps growing, we want you in our AMERICAS region.


Corporate Real Estate AMERICAS - that's us! Together with our global colleagues, we offer excellent services along the property lifecycle Commercial, Construction and Facility Management for all DPDHL properties in a sustainable way. We ensure that DPDHL develops and grows in the future.

Ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of CRE? Join the team and bring your expertise on board! As part of DPDHL, you will be working with a global network of CRE colleagues and benefit from a wide range of development opportunities.


Job Purpose:

Corporate governance and strategic, technical, and system-level management of MHE (Material Handling Equipment) within DHL’s contractual scope. Responsible for supporting and driving fleet optimization initiatives in alignment with each site’s Operations Manager, ensuring process standardization, operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and cost reduction.

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo
A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.
Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Prestar suporte técnico aos nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções com empatia e proatividade, garantindo que eles tenham a melhor experiência possível ao utilizarem nossos produtos. -Escalar problemas mais complexos para outros níveis quando necessário;
-Analisar e debugar códigos (com orientação para casos mais complexos);
-Integração com várias áreas da empresa como consultoria, engenharia e custo

title: [Job-26705] Senior Data Engineer, Campinas, Brazil (Hybrid)
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.
With over 8,000 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team on an exciting Project for a major American investment client.
This position requires a hybrid work model (3x/week) at our office in Campinas, SP, Brazil.
Responsibilities:
Build and maintain end-to-end data pipelines in AWS, often ingesting data from multiple REST APIs.
Design reliable, observable, and scalable pipelines, with a strong focus on data quality and monitoring.
Explain and discuss the logic of your solutions with stakeholders, not just the tools used.
Requirements:
Advanced English, comfortable explaining technical solutions in conversation.
Proven experience as a Data Engineer
Strong hands-on experience in Python (data processing, API integration, automation) and advanced SQL (CTEs, window functions, optimization).
Solid experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines on AWS , including:
Ingestion from REST APIs (authentication, pagination, rate limiting, error handling).
Transformation and loading into data lakes / data warehouses.
Orchestration (e.g. Step Functions, Glue Workflows, or similar).
Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless and data ecosystem :
Lambda, Glue (Glue Jobs / Glue Studio), DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate (if applicable).
S3, IAM, CloudWatch (logs, metrics, alarms), Step Functions.

title: Estágio em Mídias Sociais
description: Descrição Profissional em formação com perfil analítico e visão estratégica para atuar na área de Inteligência e Performance com foco em Programação e produto. Será responsável por apoiar as atividades de coleta, tratamento e análise de dados de consumo de conteúdo nos meios de TV, rádio e digitais; gerando insights para colaborar nas decisões sobre grade de programação, formatos, horários, públicos e distribuição multiplataforma. Responsabilidades e atribuições • Apoiar o monitoramento e a análise de desempenho de conteúdos e produtos em diferentes plataformas, com foco em hábitos de consumo, engajamento e alcance. • Produzir relatórios recorrentes com indicadores de audiência, retenção, consumo por faixa horária, perfil de público, entre outros. • Realizar decupagem de conteúdo em diferentes plataformas para análises de desempenho. • Apoiar as áreas de Programação e produto com análises comparativas, estudos de tendência e simulações de cenários. • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados para gerar recomendações baseadas em evidências.  Requisitos e qualificações • Formação superior (cursando) em Estatística; Ciência de Dados; Ciências da Computação; Matemática; Engenharia, Economia, Administração ou áreas relacionadas. • Raciocínio analítico: capacidade de interpretar dados e identificar padrões relevantes.  • Conhecimento de Excel e planilhas: fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos.  • Capacidade de interpretar dados e informações e sugerir possíveis insights  • Foco; boa comunicação e organização para apresentação de insights de forma clara e objetiva.

title: Assistente Administrativo
description:

operacionais da Central de Exibição da EPTV. Sua missão envolve desde apoio à
equipe de exibição até o suporte logístico e administrativo, garantindo que
todos os insumos e processos necessários estejam disponíveis e em conformidade
com os padrões do Grupo EP. Responsabilidades e atribuições Apoio Técnico e Operacional de Programação e no ambiente de
Exibição. Suporte de Ingest e checagem dos materiais inseridos, garantindo

para exibição. Acompanhamento dos processos de grade, como o Guia de
Programação Globo/EPTV, elaboração e envio de informativos e demais grades da
emissora. Controlar o estoque de materiais de
escritório via sistema Fluig, antecipando necessidades para evitar interrupções
na rotina da área. Alimentar planilhas e relatórios da
Central de Exibição com informações complementares, garantindo a precisão dos
dados operacionais. Auxiliar os Controladores de
Programação na organização e preenchimento de documentos administrativos
inerentes ao processo de trabalho. Apoiar nas reservas de passagens e
hospedagens, gerenciando custos, orçamentos e horários para atender às demandas
do departamento, quando necessário. Solicitar o agendamento de

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.   • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.

title: Editor Texto e Imagem
description:
Sobre nós

A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Quais são as funções do cargo?

  • Diagramar provas, simulados e materiais avaliativos conforme identidade visual da instituição.
  • Garantir padronização de estilos, espaçamento, tipografia e hierarquia visual.
  • Preparar arquivos finais para impressão e/ou publicação digital.
  • Realizar ajustes finos em textos, tabelas, imagens e fórmulas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com revisores, designers e autores nos processos de preparação dos instrumentos.
  • Manter e atualizar templates e guias de diagramação.
  • Otimizar processos gráficos visando agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.

O que é preciso para darmos #match

  • Experiência em diagramação editorial, preferencialmente de provas, livros didáticos ou materiais educacionais.
  • Domínio de Adobe InDesign (essencial) e conhecimento de Illustrator, Photoshop e Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de normas gráficas e boas práticas de editoração.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso estético e excelente organização.
  • Capacidade de lidar com prazos curtos e alto volume de materiais.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

Missão do cargo

Atuar de forma estratégica e consultiva no processo comercial, realizando o acompanhamento de orçamentos, atendimento ativo à carteira de clientes e prospecção de novos negócios, com foco em relacionamento, fidelização e geração de oportunidades. Ensino médio completo

Colaboração, abertura para aprender, orientação para resultado, responsabilidade pessoal, responsabilidades com recursos, relacionamento interpessoal, inovação e pensamento crítico.

Comunicação clara e persuasiva; Proatividade; Foco em resultado; Relacionamento interpessoal; Organização e gestão de tempo; Resiliência e persistência; Escuta ativa; Capacidade analítica; Adaptabilidade; Criatividade e inovação.

Competências técnicas

Necessário experiência em distribuição, vendas corporativas (B2B), gerenciamento de carteira de clientes, captação ativa de clientes, elaboração de propostas comerciais, gerenciamento do processo de venda, vivência e facilidade na utilização de sistemas ERP (cadastro de clientes, geração de orçamentos, propostas, consulta de produtos etc.).

Diferencial experiência com vendas de produtos

TI, segurança eletrônica, informática, materiais elétricos, ferramentas, network (cabeamento estruturado, cabeamento óptico, ativos de redes e acessórios), comunicação unificada (PABX, telefones IP, softwares Call center, Virtualização, Cloud, CRM).

Atividades

  2. Gerenciar a carteira, definindo de forma planejada um grupo de clientes para serem contatados diariamente por telefone ou via web visitas, garantindo a manutenção do relacionamento com os clientes e oportunidades de novos negócios.
  3. Elaborar orçamentos para envio aos clientes por e-mail e/ou WhatsApp, conforme demanda, iniciando assim o processo de venda e registro no sistema interno da necessidade e do interesse dos clientes em relação aos produtos e serviços oferecidos.
  4. Registrar e acompanhar os pedidos de venda, acessando diariamente o sistema interno, garantindo o avanço entre as etapas do processo até a entrega da mercadoria ao cliente.
  5. Recuperar clientes inativos, identificando semanalmente na base de dados cliente que fez apenas uma compra isolada ou que tenha realizado a última compra a mais de 90 dias. Estudar o cliente e definir a estratégia mais adequada de abordagem para recuperá-lo e realizar contato.

  7. Conhecer e seguir os procedimentos internos relacionados a crédito, expedição, entrega de mercadorias e processos de RMA, garantindo conformidade nas operações.
  8. Analisar tendências de mercado e sugerir ações comerciais, com foco em inovação, atração de novos clientes e aumento do volume de vendas.

  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to support delivery and execution across our Sales Enablement and Frontline experience teams. In this role, you’ll contribute to initiatives that span multiple tools and workflows used by our sales and customer-facing teams. You\'ll work closely with senior PMs, designers, engineers, and go-to-market partners to help scope, prioritize, and deliver features that improve productivity, consistency, and experience across our frontline ecosystem.

More about you

  • You\'re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;

  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Product Manager Campinas, Brazil
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user‑centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision‑making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium‑to‑large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem‑solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high‑quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user‑centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

Demographic Brazil

ABInBev is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce and culture. We conduct confidential surveys to better understand & ensure we provide equal opportunity throughout our end-to-end recruitment process. Individuals seeking employment at ABInBev are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

When you apply to a job on this site, the personal information contained in your application will be collected by ABINBEV SERVICES LLC. Your personal information will be processed in accordance with the law for the purposes of managing ABINBEV’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes.

On a voluntarily basis and subject to receiving your express consent, you’ll be asked demographic questions about your ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation and ability status. We collect this information for the purposes of supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce - it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter and all information will be reviewed collectively rather than individually. We won’t sell or share this information with third parties, but please note that we use Greenhouse Software Inc to manage the recruitment and hiring process on our behalf.

Your personal information will be retained by us for 2 (two) years from collection. You have the right to request access to your personal information, to request that your personal information be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted at any time. You can do so by contacting if you are located outside Europe, and emailing if you are located in Europe. We expect that our procedures will deal fairly and promptly with your request. About the job: Quality Assurance Engineer

Quality Assurance Engineer (QA) with TypeScript and Node.js

Position Overview

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at The Methodical Group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and usability of our applications built on TypeScript and Node.js foundations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and designers, to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs and exceed their expectations.

  • Test Planning and Strategy: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies based on project requirements and specifications. Identify testing objectives, scope, and priorities to ensure thorough test coverage.

  • Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects using issue tracking systems. Collaborate with development teams to investigate and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Automation Testing: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using testing frameworks and libraries specific to TypeScript and Node.js. Continuously enhance test automation frameworks to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Quality Assurance Processes: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA processes, tools, and methodologies. Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for software quality assurance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, provide feedback on design and functionality, and ensure alignment with quality standards.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, test reports, and other relevant artifacts. Ensure that documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and accessible to team members.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in quality assurance/testing of web applications, preferably using TypeScript and Node.js technologies.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Proficiency in test automation using testing frameworks/tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools is desirable.

description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Garantir a qualidade técnica e funcional das entregas do produto, atuando de forma colaborativa com o time de desenvolvimento para promover práticas de automação, prevenção de defeitos e melhoria contínua. O desafio principal é garantir entregas seguras, estáveis e com alto padrão de qualidade, contribuindo para a maturidade dos processos de teste e observabilidade.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Atuar no planejamento, execução e automação de testes funcionais, regressivos e exploratórios.
  • Validar integrações entre APIs e microsserviços, garantindo cobertura e rastreabilidade dos testes.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação (backend) integrados ao pipeline CI/CD.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na identificação e prevenção de defeitos desde as etapas iniciais.
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e discussões técnicas voltadas à qualidade e desempenho.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz para falhas recorrentes e propor soluções de melhoria.
  • Apoiar a evolução de métricas de qualidade e observabilidade (defeitos, cobertura, tempo de execução).
  • Colaborar com o time na priorização e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de qualidade e testes automatizados entre os colegas do time.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência em automação de testes de API (Postman, RestAssured ou similares).
  • Experiência em automação de testes utilizando as linguagens Python, Java ou Javascript.
  • Experiência em elaboração e execução de Testes Funcionais, Testes Não-Funcionais (testes de performance e usabilidade).
  • Níveis de teste: Testes Unitários, Testes Integração/Serviço, Testes de Sistema.
  • Técnicas de teste: Caixa branca, Caixa preta, Exploratórios.
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes web (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou equivalentes). Vivência com pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Bitbucket).
  • Experiência em análise de logs, troubleshooting e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Domínio em versionamento (Git) e boas práticas de testes em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados SQL e NoSQL para validação de dados.
  • Capacidade de escrever cenários de teste com clareza e alinhamento aos critérios de aceite.

Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência com produtos regulatórios.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Experiência em testes de performance (JMeter, k6) e segurança (OWASP).
  • Contribuições em comunidades técnicas, QA Guilds ou projetos open source.
  • Atuação prévia com frameworks de BDD (Cucumber, Behave).
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas kubernetes, docker.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.
  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

title: Product Manager - Personalization
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user-centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision-making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user-centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Senior Global Recruiter
description:
Overview

About Nu
Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company leads an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

People and Culture at Nubank

Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank’s culture. We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders. You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values. We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive full-cycle recruitment
  • Build strong, consultative partnerships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and advising on best hiring practices.
  • Source and engage passive candidates through creative channels and market research.
  • Deliver high-touch candidate experiences that reflect Nubank’s values of transparency, empathy, and simplicity.
  • Use data and metrics to inform recruiting strategies and continuously improve pipeline health and process efficiency.
  • Partner with employer branding, people analytics, and HR teams to align hiring efforts with business goals.

You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in fast-paced, product-driven companies.
  • A strong understanding of the talent landscape, especially in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple searches and stakeholders with a solutions-oriented approach.
  • Experience with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, etc.).
  • Passion for candidate experience, inclusive hiring, and employer brand.
  • Advanced English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Nice To Have

  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Previous exposure to fintech or hypergrowth environments.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.

Benefits

  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Meal allowance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program
  • Gympass partnership
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Espaço Feijão - Private nursing and breastfeeding spaces in our buildings
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. We hire based on equality and consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting talented individuals.

title: Analista de Precificação e Custos Pleno
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Na SIS , somos apaixonados pela excelência e pela dedicação aos nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso é oferecer soluções de segurança de alta qualidade e confiabilidade, e nosso sucesso começa com a nossa equipe. Estamos à procura de um(a) Analista de Precificação e Custos Pl. altamente qualificado para se juntar a nós.

O/A Analista de Precificação e Custos

Será essencial no apoio à formação e atualização de preços dos serviços prestados, estruturando modelos de pricing, elaborando rate cards e realizando simulações de impactos (dissídio, benefícios, encargos e mudanças de escala).

Este profissional será responsável por mapear e controlar custos diretos e indiretos, acompanhar drivers de rentabilidade, apoiar análises de margem por contrato e garantir rastreabilidade das premissas utilizadas. Atuará também na padronização de processos, automatização de rotinas e na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais que suportem decisões estratégicas do negócio.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Apoiar na formação, atualização e controle de preços de serviços (postos/hora/escala/região/cliente);
  • Estruturar e manter modelos de precificação (custo + markup / preço-alvo / cenários);
  • Elaborar e atualizar rate cards (tabelas de preço) por tipo de serviço e unidade;
  • Simular impactos de reajustes salariais/dissídio, benefícios, encargos, inflação e mudanças de escala/turnos;
  • Garantir trilha de evidências e versionamento das premissas utilizadas nas propostas;
  • Mapear e atualizar custos diretos (mão de obra, benefícios, adicionais, horas extras, coberturas, insumos) e custos indiretos/overhead (supervisão, estrutura, G&A);
  • Definir e acompanhar drivers de custo: custo/hora, custo/posto, custo por escala, absenteísmo, turnover, cobertura, deslocamento;
  • Apoiar análises de rentabilidade e margem por contrato/cliente/serviço, indicando desvios e oportunidades de correção;
  • Atualizar e acompanhar indicadores de margem bruta e margem de contribuição por contrato;
  • Apoiar a construção e atualização de relatórios gerenciais (mensal/semanal): margem, custos, variações e desempenho por contrato;
  • Apoiar o fechamento mensal com conciliações e validações relacionadas a custos e rentabilidade (quando aplicável);
  • Suportar auditorias internas/externas com organização de evidências e rastreabilidade das premissas e bases utilizadas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência prévia com precificação, custos, controladoria ou FP&A (preferencialmente em serviços);
  • Excel/Sheets avançado (PROCV/XLOOKUP, SOMASES, ÍNDICE/CORRESP, Tabela Dinâmica, cenários);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interface com Comercial e Operações;
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes (rastreabilidade e premissas).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ERP (TOTVS/SAP/Oracle/NetSuite ou similares);
  • Power BI / Looker Studio e Power Query;
  • Experiência com RFPs/propostas e governança de pricing;
  • Conhecimento de custos de mão de obra (encargos/benefícios/adicionais/escala).

Informações Adicionais

  • Benefícios de VR e VT sem desconto na folha de pagamento;
  • Gympass;

Banco de Talentos de Team Leader

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo - Venha fazer parte da Sensedia!

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos multilinguagens para profissionais que compartilham nossa paixão por tecnologia, integração digital, microsserviços e inovação. Se você quer fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à transformação digital, seu lugar pode ser aqui!

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Banco?

Este é um banco de talentos para Team Leader aqui na Sensensedia! Você pode se cadastrar e demonstrar seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time, mesmo que ainda não tenhamos uma vaga aberta compatível com o seu perfil, se surgir uma oportunidade, analisaremos seu fit com a posição e caso dê match, entraremos em contato!

Conhecimentos técnicos que buscamos para vagas de Team Leader da Sensedia

Obs: não é necessário ter todos os conhecimentos descritos abaixo, buscamos abranger diversos profissionais com conhecimentos diferentes.

  • Experiência prévia com liderança de pessoas e times de tecnologia;
  • Background técnico em TI;
  • Vivência como Scrum Master, Agilista ou Líder de Projetos;
  • Domínio de práticas e metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira ou Azure DevOps;
  • Ser o ponto focal entre cliente e equipe de desenvolvimento;
  • Aplicar práticas ágeis, monitorar atividades e coletar métricas de produtividade;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental do time, com avaliações e feedbacks contínuos;
  • Garantir organização da equipe (controle de ponto, férias, ausências);
  • Estimular o engajamento com eventos, iniciativas internas e cultura Sensedia.

O Fit Cultural da Sensedia

  • #DoEpicShit | Focamos em excelência para gerar resultados, valor e alto desempenho, superando desafios.
  • #Ownership | Liderança pelo exemplo e responsabilidade. Criação de um ambiente seguro para o desenvolvimento da equipe, a resolução de conflitos e a autonomia.
  • #AwesomePeople | Construir e manter relações interpessoais positivas e influenciar pessoas de forma construtiva, visando alcançar objetivos comuns da organização
  • #Solve4TheCustomer | Organizar, executar e gerir entregáveis com comunicação clara com o cliente. Identificar oportunidades internas e externas de novos negócios.
  • #ThinkBIg | Busca constantemente novas maneiras de fazer as coisas, aprimorar processos, produtos e serviços, e estimular a criatividade dentro da equipe e organização.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Multibenefícios via cartão Flash, Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.
  • Temos#WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
  • Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD!

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos eambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão émapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)

*Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018

title: ASSISTENTE DE MANUTENÇÃO - CPS Campinas - SP Full-time employee
description:
Overview

EXECUTAM SERVIÇOS DE MANUTENÇÃO ELÉTRICA, MECÂNICA, HIDRÁULICA, CARPINTARIA E ALVENARIA, SUBSTITUINDO, TROCANDO, ACESSÓRIOS E TRATAM DE PISCINAS. TRABALHAM SEGUINDO NORMAS DE SEGURANÇA, HIGIENE, QUALIDADE E PROTEÇÃO AO MEIO AMBIENTE.

Executam serviços de manutenção elétrica, mecânica, hidráulica, carpintaria e alvenaria, substituindo, trocando, limpando, reparando e instalando peças, componentes e equipamentos. Conservam vidros e fachadas, limpam recintos, acessórios e tratam de piscinas. Trabalham seguindo normas de segurança, higiene, qualidade e proteção ao meio ambiente.

Somos uma empresa de construtores: desde 1970, quando um jovem engenheiro decidiu fundar a Plaenge, nosso propósito sempre foi claro: ser uma empresa sólida, ética e com impacto real na vida das pessoas. Mais de 55 anos depois, temos orgulho do que construímos: obras que transformam cidades, relações baseadas em respeito e confiança, e uma equipe que cresce junto com a nossa história.

Responsibilities

  • Realizar manutenção elétrica, mecânica, hidráulica, carpintaria e alvenaria, incluindo substituição, troca, limpeza, reparo e instalação de peças, componentes e equipamentos.
  • Conservar vidros e fachadas, limpar recintos e acessórios, e tratar de piscinas.
  • Seguir normas de segurança, higiene, qualidade e proteção ao meio ambiente.
